Same model, different harness

You replay a run that claims it is done, then change one setting.

Break

Predict whether the run really finished before you replay it.

See

An agent is a model in a loop with tools. Each model call returns a reply, and the reply says why it stopped.

A harness is everything around the model: the prompt, the tools, the limits and the checks. Change the harness and the same model can score differently.

Each run is measured as a pass rate over many seeded trials.

You will meet type hints later, when the code gets typed.
